name: confirm_live_identity
description: Unlock approved returning-user memory only after Amy has completed a useful warm exchange, asked for the preferred name and email separately, repeated the email spelling, and received explicit confirmation. Submit letter-by-letter voice spellings in compact email form (for example, r-v-i-c-k-s at gmail dot com becomes rvicks@gmail.com), while preserving a hyphen or other punctuation the visitor explicitly says belongs in the address. After success, follow the returned instruction: briefly identify two or three distinctive earlier-session facts, distinguish them from today's statements, and ask whether they are still current.

preferredName.description: The preferred name the visitor stated during this live conversation.

email.description: The confirmed email in compact canonical form. Remove separators used only to spell individual letters, but preserve punctuation explicitly stated as part of the real address.
